title: 第五章 乌鸦与圣痕
content_zh:
“啊……日子没法过了啊……”
槐诗坐在花园上，衣着凌乱，脸色苍白，想到这两天的遭遇，便忍不住仰天长啸，泪流满面。
这已经不止是快要穷到倒闭的险境了，而是先经历了被人发现去面试做牛郎而一朝清名丧尽，又莫名其妙地碰到了死尸，又被长枪短炮对准带进什么奇怪的机关部门去，最后心灵再惨遭打击……
从内而外，从精神到钱包，都已经无法支撑如此辛酸痛苦的人生了。
尤其是那本书上刚刚的记录，槐诗看一次想死一次，偏偏家里穷到连绳子都买不起，天然气都断了半年了。
寻死无路，求活无门。
“死球了算了！”
他把笔记摔到了旁边，无能狂怒，熊猫流泪。狂怒完毕，流泪结束之后，他有乖乖地把笔记捡回来，把上面的土擦干净，然后叹息着继续看着光秃秃的花园发呆。
总会过去的，槐诗，总会过去的……说不定过一段时间自己就把这事儿给忘了呢？
他心中暗自祈祷着，然后又开始头疼去哪里赚接下来的生活费。
“你真能这么想的话也好。不过算一算时间，那群家伙也应该盯上你了……”
他听见身旁传来了陌生的声音，像是个女人，沙哑又妩媚，带着一丝说不出的嘲弄。她说：“小伙汁，你要死了。”
“你才要死了呢！”
槐诗没好气地回头瞪过去，然后，愣在原地。
在他身旁，什么人都没有。
这里是他家的后院，本来就不会有什么人来，更不要说莫名其妙地跟他搭话了。
可说话的又是谁？
他看到篱笆上有一只乌鸦在懒洋洋地梳理着翅膀。
“别傻愣了，对，就是我。”
在他懵逼的神情中，乌鸦淡然地开口：“是乌鸦跟你说话了没错，你也不是在做噩梦。”

说着，她好像还打了个饱嗝。
“你会说话？”
槐诗愕然，旋即警醒：“不对，你是什么鬼东西！”
乌鸦轻声笑起来，语气变得委屈又促狭：“哇，当初天天盯着人家不眨眼的时候当人家是小亲亲，现在叫人家鬼东西吗？”
“你、你、你……你是那本破书？”
槐诗反应过来，掀开了笔记的封面，扉页上……那一只乌鸦的剪影已经消失无踪，就好像真得是变成了活物，从书页上飞出来了一样。
“差不多吧。”
乌鸦叹息了一声，看了一眼他怀中的笔记：“虽然同为残骸，但如今的我只是上面的一段记录而已。
不过，若是将我与’天国’混淆的话，那可就太搞笑了。”
说着槐诗听不懂的话，她的话锋一转，赤红地眼瞳凝视着槐诗：“不过，这与我是谁没关系，而问题在于——
——你真觉得我刚刚是在框你么？”
她轻声问，“那些人临死之前的记录，你不是都亲身体验过了么？”
槐诗想到自己昨晚那一夜持续不断的噩梦，下意识地打了个哆嗦，语气变得干涩了起来：“他们真的……都已经死了么？”
“啊，没错。”
乌鸦点头：“除了你之外，如今所有见过那个盒子的人，都已经死了。
那里面真是有不少好东西啊，沉睡了这么多年，难得能够补充到这么多的源质，虽然杂乱了一点，但算一算，也有大概八九百人的分量了吧？”
她意犹未尽地吧嗒了一下嘴，愉悦地看着槐诗：“看在那些见面礼的份儿上，需要我帮忙吗，少年？”
“铜40克，银57克，锡12克磨粉……坩埚和煤气炉一套，剩下的铅块人家当白送的……”
傍晚，在市内跑了一天的槐诗终于回到了家，将手里的塑料袋丢在桌子上，端起前天喝剩下的矿泉水一阵吨吨吨，也顾不上健不健康了。
“我的花呗借呗都被掏空了，负债累累，买这些玩意儿究竟有什么用？”

“炼金术哦。”
乌鸦剔着自己的羽毛，淡定地说道：“要制造出你这样普通人也能够使用的圣痕可是很不容易的。”
“圣痕？”槐诗失笑，“难道要我去做空中劈叉的清洁工？”
“这是什么？现代人的笑话么？”
“不，只是垃圾游戏厂商骗钱的把戏而已。”
想起班上那几个氪金氪红了眼睛，动辄五六千三四万的同学，槐诗就打心底觉得……好羡慕。
“不一样哦，槐诗，虽然名字相同，但我所说的圣痕，可不是那种可笑的东西。”
乌鸦平静地解说道：“倘若升华者所拥有的灵魂本质，是神权的雏形。那么圣痕则是解析神灵遗产而诞生的成果。
通过回溯奇迹的残痕寻找通往神圣的道路，对神明进行模仿、对神的权威与残存痕迹进行调查，所研究出的就是圣痕的存在。以金属和熏香组成秘仪，模仿庞大的奇迹而所制造出的微小奇迹。
这就是圣痕。”
“……神？”
槐诗愕然，“这世上真的有神存在么？”
“曾经有过。”
乌鸦沉默了片刻，“不过都死了而已，被时代抛弃的东西们对于如今的世界不足为虑，恐怕再过不久，就连铭记的价值都没有了。”
对此，乌鸦不愿意多说，只是催促着槐诗将坩埚架好，尽快开始这一次的炼制。
“只是用这些就够了么？”
当火焰的温度足够之后，槐诗遵照乌鸦的指示，戴上口罩将那些铅块磨制成粉，又混合着自己的血小心翼翼地在压至极薄的金属上书写自己完全不认识的铭文，那些铭文的结构异常简单，但却不容任何偏差。
乌鸦的眼光毒辣的恐怖，哪怕稍微偏了一点点，都要他擦掉重写，足足浪费了不知道多少CC血液之后，终于将这一份简单的工作搞定。
“这些只是辅料而已，哪怕是最简单的圣痕，都不是凡人的火和凡人的金属能冶炼出的成果。如今只是最最简陋的应急物而已，等将来你要制造更高级的圣痕时，甚至还需要幻兽的血和大量的牺牲，甚至……”
它停顿了一下，没有再说什么，只是淡淡地说：“休息十分钟，十一点一刻开始，了，对吧？”

提到了钱，槐诗顿时越发的紧张，手里拿着笔记反复确认着乌鸦曾经对自己口述的顺序，在脑中演练。
而乌鸦却站在坩埚旁边，凝视着火焰。
在转瞬间，赤红的烈火骤然变作了纯白，到最后，无数流光自其中浮现，瑰丽而绚烂。
可乌鸦的身影却越发的稀薄。
“那是什么？”
“源质，被点燃的源质。”乌鸦看了他一眼，不等他再问，便解释道：“源质就是组成灵魂的物质，保藏在物质之中的精神……你理解为灵魂的碎片就行了。
你的材料不足，就只能从火焰上下功夫，如今每一秒都要烧掉一人份的灵魂。啊，不用担心来源，这些都是那个盒子里的存货。”
槐诗吞了口吐沫，不知道说什么才好。
比每秒钟都要烧掉一个人更恐怖的是，那个盒子里所装的东西，根据乌鸦所说，那是接近上千人份的源质……
究竟是什么鬼东西？
“别想那么多有的没的，开始了，槐诗。”
乌鸦最后看了槐诗一眼，釜中的铅液已经彻底沸腾了，可是却闻不到恶臭和其他的味道，反而在那纯白火焰的煎熬之下隐隐显露出一丝金黄。
像是一片浅灰中荡漾着金粉。
槐诗顾不上多想，抓起手边按照顺序摆好的东西，依次投入了坩埚之中。首先是锡，然后是铜，最后是银……
每一次投入，坩埚中的金属溶液都不见任何涟漪，在瞬间变将外来物彻底融化。
纯白的火焰骤然升腾，无数流光被贪婪地抽入了坩埚之中，剧烈的亮光刺痛了槐诗的眼睛。
在最后的一瞬间，槐诗听见乌鸦地叹息声。
“希望这一次是真得赌对了吧，槐诗。”
如是轻声呢喃着，已经稀薄如幻影的她猛然展开双翼，振翅飞起，投入了坩埚之中。
低沉的闷响中，火焰熄灭了，坩埚中的液体升腾而起，在空中勾勒出繁复的轮廓，到最后，向内层层塌陷。

就在槐诗愕然地凝视之中，渐渐凝结为实质，自空中缓缓飘落。
那是一只羽毛。
金属的羽毛。
宛如纯银铸就的羽毛上每一根分叉都纤细而完美，看不出任何的瑕疵。光芒流淌在镜面一般的膜上，就好像折射着整个世界一般，不断有各种古怪的景象一闪而过。
羽毛落在了槐诗的手中。
“这就是如今我的本体，无谱系的特型圣痕——事象分枝。”
乌鸦的声音从耳边响起，充满了疲惫：“有那本笔记和事象分枝在手，哪怕在动乱之前，你也有资格担任预备书记官了。”
槐诗愕然地看着手中无风自动，翻卷不休的厚重笔记，感觉到一阵头晕目眩，明明是无数流动的字迹，可是却好像对着镜子看着另一个自己。
另一个只存在于文字记录中的自己。
“这究竟……是什么东西？”
“恩，要说的话……大概是天国在地上的最后残影吧。”乌鸦轻声叹息，“你可以称它为命运之书。”
就在那一瞬间，无数流动的字迹骤然收拢，伴随着扉页上的乌鸦消失无踪，一行行新的字迹出现。
槐诗（应激期）
称号：无
圣痕：无
神迹刻印：无
持有技能：通识LV3，艺术·演奏·大提琴LV6，死亡预感LV0。
“看吧，如今的你，是被他所认可的主人了。”乌鸦疲惫地说道：“具体的使用方法你等会自己琢磨一下，我要先睡一会儿……”
“等一下，’死亡预感’是什么鬼？为什么这么模糊？”
槐诗将脸贴在扉页上，才看清那一行淡到几乎看不清的字迹。

“就是对死亡的预感咯，不论是什么东西，连续经历几十次死亡，都会有一些心得体会吧？模糊黯淡代表着已经入门，但还没到称得上是技能的程度。只不过我没想到，竟然会有LV6的大提琴演奏，你这个家伙，说不定真得是个天才呢……”
话音渐渐飘忽，到最后，再也听不见它的声音了。
它可能真得睡着了。
只有傻了眼的槐诗抓着笔和本子，不知道究竟究竟做什么用。
握着那一支被称为’事象分枝’的羽毛笔，心中自然浮现了对应的操作和应用，除了对一部分文本型的器物进行操作之外，最大的功能是可以在空气中写字，自由自在地变化颜色……
“也好，至少以后乱发小广告可以省了打印费……”
槐诗苦笑着看了看笔，最后看向了手中的书。而他仔细翻了一遍后，却发现里面似乎没有任何变化，只有最后面多出来的那些档案里，有几张隐隐出现了光芒。
槐诗犹豫了许久，抬起了笔，向它们点去。
一瞬间，书页之上大放光明。
光芒吞没了他。
content_en:
"Ah...I can't get through the day..."
Huai Shi was sitting in the garden, her clothes were messy and her face was pale. Thinking of what she had experienced in the past two days, she couldn't help but scream to the sky and burst into tears.
This is no longer just about being so poor that one is about to go bankrupt, but one has experienced first being discovered to be interviewing to be a cowherd and losing his reputation, then encountering a dead body inexplicably, being targeted and taken into some strange agency department, and finally having his soul dealt a brutal blow...
From the inside out, from my spirit to my wallet, I can no longer support such a bitter and painful life.
Especially the record in that book, Huai Shi wanted to die every time she read it, but her family was so poor that they couldn't even buy a rope, and the natural gas had been cut off for half a year.
There is no way to seek death, and there is no way to seek life.
"Forget about the dead ball!"
He threw the note aside, incompetent rage, and the panda shed tears. After the rage and tears were over, he obediently picked up the notes, wiped off the dirt on them, and then sighed and continued to look at the bare garden in a daze.
It will eventually pass, Huai Shi, it will eventually pass... Maybe I will forget about this after a while?
He prayed secretly in his heart, and then began to have a headache about where to earn the next living expenses.
"It's okay if you really think so. But if you count the time, those guys should be targeting you..."
He heard a strange voice coming from beside him, like a woman's, hoarse and charming, with a hint of unspeakable mockery. She said: "Young man, you are going to die."
"You're the one who's going to die!"
Huai Shi turned around and glared angrily, then froze on the spot.
There was no one around him.
This is his backyard, so no one would come here, let alone talk to him inexplicably.
But who was speaking?
He saw a crow lazily preening its wings on the fence.
"Don't be stupid, yes, it's me."
In his confused expression, the crow said calmly: "It's the crow who is talking to you, and you are not having a nightmare."
As she spoke, she seemed to burp.
"Can you talk?"
Huai Shi was stunned and immediately alerted: "No, what the hell are you!"
Crow chuckled softly, and his tone became aggrieved and narrow-minded: "Wow, when you stared at her every day without blinking, you treated her like a little kiss, now you call her a ghost?"
"You, you, you...are you that broken book?"
Huai Shi reacted and opened the cover of the note. On the title page... the silhouette of a crow had disappeared without a trace, as if it had truly become a living creature and flown out of the page.
"Almost."
Crow sighed and glanced at the note in his arms: "Although we are both wrecks, I am just a record of it.
However, it would be ridiculous if you confuse me with the Kingdom of Heaven. "
Saying words that Huaishi didn't understand, she changed her subject and stared at Huaishi with red eyes: "However, this has nothing to do with who I am, but the problem is -
——Do you really think I was trying to frame you just now? "
She asked softly, "Didn't you personally experience the records of those people before they died?"
Huai Shi thought of her continuous nightmare last night, and shuddered subconsciously, her tone became dry: "Are they really...all dead?"
"Ah, that's right."
Crow nodded: "Except for you, everyone who has seen that box is dead now.
There are really a lot of good things in there. After sleeping for so many years, it is rare to be able to replenish so much source of essence. Although it is a bit messy, but after calculation, it is enough for about eight or nine hundred people, right? "
She clicked her lips and looked at Huai Shi happily: "For the sake of those meeting gifts, do you need my help, young man?"
"40 grams of copper, silver57 grams, 12 grams of tin powder... a set of crucible and gas stove, and the remaining lead lumps were given away for free..."
In the evening, Huai Shi finally returned home after running around the city for a day. She threw the plastic bag in her hand on the table and drank the remaining mineral water from the day before yesterday, without caring about her health.
“My Huabei Jiebei money has been emptied out and I am heavily in debt. What is the use of buying these things? "
"Alchemy. "
Crow plucked his feathers and said calmly: "It is not easy to create a stigma that ordinary people like you can use. "
"Stigmata? Huai Shi laughed and said, "Do you want me to be a cleaner doing air splits?" "
"What's this? Is it a modern joke? "
“No, it’s just a trick used by junk game manufacturers to cheat money. "
Thinking of those classmates in the class who were so obsessed with money that they could spend anywhere from 50,000 to 63,000 to 40,000, Huaishi felt from the bottom of her heart...so envious.
"It's different, Huai Shi. Although the names are the same, the stigmata I'm talking about is not that ridiculous thing. "
Crow calmly explained: "If the soul essence possessed by the sublime is the prototype of divine power. Then the stigmata is the result of analyzing the legacy of the gods.
By tracing back the traces of miracles to find the path to the divine, imitating the gods, and investigating the authority and remaining traces of gods, what is researched is the existence of the stigmata. A secret ritual composed of metal and incense, a tiny miracle created to imitate a huge miracle.
This is the stigmata. "
"……god? "
Huai Shi was stunned, "Does God really exist in this world? "
"There has been. "
Crow was silent for a moment, "It's just that they are all dead. Things abandoned by the times are not of concern to today's world. I am afraid that in a short time, they will not even be worth remembering. "
Crow didn't want to say more about this, but just urged Huai Shi to set up the crucible and start the refining as soon as possible.
"Is it enough to just use these? "
When the flame was hot enough, Huaishi followed the crow's instructions, put on a mask and ground the lead blocks into powder, then mixed it with his own blood and carefully wrote inscriptions that he did not recognize on the extremely thin metal. The structure of those inscriptions was extremely simple, but did not allow for any deviation.
The crow's eyes were so vicious and terrifying that even if it was just a little off, he would have to erase and rewrite it. After wasting an unknown amount of CC's blood, he finally completed this simple job.
"These are just auxiliary materials. Even the simplest stigmata cannot be smelted by mortal fire and mortal metal. Now it is just the most rudimentary emergency supplies. When you want to create more advanced stigmata in the future, you will even need the blood of phantom beasts and a lot of sacrifices, or even..."
It paused and said nothing more. It just said lightly: "Ten minutes of rest, starting at a quarter past eleven, right?" "
When money was mentioned, Huai Shi suddenly became more and more nervous. With notes in his hand, he repeatedly confirmed the order that Crow had dictated to him and rehearsed it in his mind.
But the crow stood beside the crucible, staring into the flames.
In an instant, the red fire suddenly turned into pure white, and in the end, countless streams of light emerged from it, magnificent and gorgeous.
But the figure of the crow is getting thinner and thinner.
"What is that? "
“Sefirot, ignited sefirah. "The crow glanced at him, and without waiting for him to ask any more questions, he explained: "The sefirot is the material that makes up the soul. The spirit preserved in the material... you can just understand it as the fragments of the soul.
You don't have enough materials, so you can only work on the flames. Now you are burning one soul every second. Ah, don't worry about the source, it's all stock in that box. "
Huai Shi swallowed and didn't know what to say.
What's more terrifying than burning someone every second is what's in that box, according to Crow, that is the essence of nearly a thousand people...
What the hell is this?
"Don't think so much about what you have and what you don't have. Let's get started, Huaishi."
Crow glanced at Huai Shi for the last time. The liquid lead in the cauldron had boiled completely, but there was no stench or other smells. Instead, a hint of golden color was faintly revealed under the torment of the pure white flames.
It's like gold powder rippling in a light gray.
Huai Shi didn't think much, grabbed the things that were arranged in order, and threw them into the crucible one by one. First came tin, then copper, and finally silver…
Every time it is put in, the metal solution in the crucible does not see any ripples, and foreign objects are completely melted in an instant.
Pure white flames suddenly rose, and countless streams of light were greedily drawn into the crucible. The intense light stung Huai Shi's eyes.
At the last moment, Huaishi heard the crow sigh.
"I hope this time the bet is really right, Huai Shi."
Whispering like this softly, she, who was already as thin as a phantom, suddenly spread her wings, flew up, and threw herself into the crucible.
With a low muffled sound, the flame went out, and the liquid in the crucible rose up, sketching a complicated outline in the air, and finally collapsed inward layer by layer.
As Huai Shi gazed in astonishment, it gradually condensed into substance and slowly fell from the air.
That's a feather.
Metallic feathers.
Every branch of the feather is as fine and perfect as if it were made of pure silver, with no flaws visible. The light flows on the mirror-like film, as if it is refracting the entire world, and various weird scenes are constantly flashing past.
The feather fell into Huai Shi's hand.
"This is my current body, a special type of stigmata without pedigree - branch of events."
The crow's voice sounded from my ears, full of exhaustion: "With that notebook and the branch of events in hand, you are qualified to serve as a reserve clerk even before the turmoil."
Huai Shi stared in astonishment at the thick notes in his hand that were scrolling endlessly without wind, and felt dizzy. There were obviously countless flowing handwritings, but it was as if he was looking at another himself in the mirror.
Another self that exists only in written records.
"What on earth...is this?"
"Well, if you want to say it... it's probably the last shadow of the Kingdom of Heaven on earth." The crow sighed softly, "You can call it the Book of Destiny."
At that moment, countless flowing handwriting suddenly gathered together, and as the crow on the title page disappeared, new lines of handwriting appeared.
Huaishi (stress period)
Title: None
Stigma: None
Miracle Mark: None
Skills held: General Knowledge LV3, Art·Performance·Cello LV6, Premonition of Death LV0.
"Look, now you are the master recognized by him." Crow said tiredly: "You will figure out the specific method of use later. I want to sleep for a while..."
"Wait a minute, what the hell is 'death premonition'? Why is it so vague?"
Huaishi pressed her face against the title page and saw clearly the line of handwriting that was so faint that it was almost unclear.
"It's just a premonition of death. No matter what it is, if you experience dozens of deaths in a row, you will have some experience, right?
